task: Build a molecule-level literature dataset of mechanistic skin sensitization evidence. Include peptide or protein reactivity, covalent haptenation, DPRA, KeratinoSens or ARE-Nrf2 activation, dendritic-cell activation such as h-CLAT, GARD, cytokine responses, and other assays corresponding to skin sensitization adverse-outcome-pathway key events.
task_instantiation:
Extract molecule-level evidence that a named small molecule, small-molecule class, defined mixture/formulation, or natural product causes or fails to cause a mechanistic event in the skin-sensitization adverse outcome pathway. In scope are: (1) molecular initiating event evidence—reaction with peptides, proteins, glutathione, or amino-acid residues; covalent adduct/hapten formation; peptide depletion; DPRA and validated variants; and explicitly described prohapten/pre-hapten activation that generates protein-reactive species; (2) keratinocyte responses—KeratinoSens, LuSens, ARE/Nrf2 activation, stress/inflammatory signaling, and molecule-specific cytokine responses in relevant keratinocyte systems; (3) dendritic-cell activation—h-CLAT, U-SENS, IL-8 Luc, CD54/CD86 or other DC markers; (4) GARD or other sensitization-relevant genomic/signature assays; (5) hapten-specific T-cell activation; and (6) molecule-specific integrated, animal, or human sensitization outcomes (e.g., Sens-IS, LLNA, human patch testing) when reported as evidence of skin sensitization or used to corroborate a mechanistic assay. Use the tested parent molecule/formulation as `global_identifier`; if the evidence concerns a metabolite or oxidation product as the tested entity, make that product a separate record when identifiable.

Create one record per tested entity × assay or evidence method × endpoint × experimental condition/result. Separate records when a passage reports distinct endpoints (e.g., IL-6 and IL-1α), distinct peptide targets (cysteine and lysine), materially different conditions, or different assay results. A single record may contain a mean and its variability in `extra_details`. For a mixture, formulation, essential oil, or compound class, create a record only when the result is explicitly attributed to that entity as a whole; do not redistribute the result to constituents. Class-level mechanistic claims are valid using the class entity. For activation-dependent sensitizers, do not attribute a reactive-product result to the parent unless the text explicitly links the parent to that activation pathway.

Require molecule-attributed evidence. Accept explicit quantitative results, explicit qualitative outcomes, and values directly readable from tables/figures. Do not invent values or positivity from an unstated threshold. Normalize an author-stated assay outcome to `positive`, `negative`, or `equivocal` in `result_label`; a clearly reported increase, induction, depletion, adduct, or reaction may be labeled `positive` for that endpoint even if the paper does not call the molecule an overall sensitizer. Conversely, assay inactivity/no depletion/no induction is `negative`. Leave `result_label` null when only a protocol, threshold, assay availability, control setup, or comparative statement is given without an entity-specific outcome. Comparatives without an absolute or qualitative endpoint are not standalone records; retain a comparison in `extra_details` only when attached to an otherwise extractable result.

Exclude assay descriptions, decision thresholds, model inputs, classification scoring schemes, positive-control preparation, and validation-set aggregate performance unless they include a result for a named entity. Exclude generic enzyme activity, ordinary chemical reactivity with non-biological reagents, non-covalent binding without a sensitization-relevant endpoint, irritation/cytotoxicity alone, respiratory allergy alone, and general claims that a compound is a sensitizer with no assay, mechanistic basis, animal result, or human result in the passage. Also exclude unrelated immune or cytokine findings unless the authors use them as skin-sensitization AOP evidence.

Map `aop_event` to the event directly measured: `MIE_protein_binding` for peptide/protein reaction, depletion, or covalent haptenation; `KE2_keratinocyte_activation`; `KE3_dendritic_cell_activation`; `KE4_T_cell_activation`; or `adverse_outcome_skin_sensitization` for LLNA, human patch, or overall sensitizer classifications. Use `integrated_or_unspecified` for integrated assays/signatures spanning events or when the event cannot be assigned. Record the exact assay/approach in `assay_type` and the measured peptide, residue, protein, biomarker, cytokine, gene signature, or sensitization endpoint in `endpoint_or_target`.

Assume ordinary assay conditions and an otherwise unmanipulated test system when the claim is unqualified. Put routine parameters such as dose/concentration, exposure time, species, cell line, vehicle, peptide, temperature, and detection method in `experimental_conditions`. Put genuinely interpretation-changing contexts—metabolic or air oxidation activation, unusual extraction/formulation, cytokine pretreatment, disease/knockout state, barrier disruption, or another exceptional manipulation—in `qualifying_conditions`; otherwise set it to null.

schema_spec.name: assay_type
schema_spec.description: Exact assay or evidence method producing the entity-specific result, e.g. DPRA, h-CLAT, KeratinoSens, GARD, LC-MS adduct analysis, LLNA, or human patch test.

schema_spec.name: aop_event
schema_spec.description: Skin-sensitization AOP event most directly measured; MIE is covalent peptide/protein binding, KE2 is keratinocyte activation, KE3 is dendritic-cell activation, and KE4 is T-cell activation.

schema_spec.name: endpoint_or_target
schema_spec.description: Specific measured endpoint or reacting target, such as cysteine depletion, lysine adduct, GSH adduct formation, ARE/Nrf2 reporter, IL-6, CD54, CD86, genomic signature, T-cell proliferation, or LLNA stimulation index.

schema_spec.name: result_label
schema_spec.description: Normalized entity-specific endpoint outcome. Use positive for a reported reaction/adduct/depletion/induction or positive sensitization call, negative for reported absence/inactivity or non-sensitizer call, equivocal for borderline/inconclusive/conflicting results; null if no outcome is stated.

schema_spec.name: result_value
schema_spec.description: Primary numeric result for this endpoint only, without units (e.g. 51.1 for mean percent depletion or 8.85 for fold change). Null for qualitative-only evidence.

schema_spec.name: result_unit
schema_spec.description: Unit or scale for result_value, e.g. %, fold, SI, EC1.5, µM, or nM. Null when no numeric result is reported.

schema_spec.name: experimental_conditions
schema_spec.description: Routine reported parameters relevant to interpreting the result, including concentration/dose, time, species, cell line, vehicle, peptide sequence, temperature, and analytical method; null if unstated.

schema_spec.name: qualifying_conditions
schema_spec.description: Exceptional context that materially limits generalization, such as required metabolism/autoxidation, unusual extraction/formulation, cytokine pretreatment, knockout/disease state, or barrier disruption. Null for standard or unqualified conditions.

schema_spec.name: extra_details
schema_spec.description: Free-form string for additional details that do not fit other top-level fields.
